sent: This heart is in sinus rhythm, but look how long it takes from each spike to the end of its T wave. [pause 0.3] That's a long Q-T. [pause 0.35] The ventricles take longer than normal to reset, and that leaves them vulnerable. [pause 0.45] Now watch what happens in torsades de pointes. [pause 0.35] A fast ventricular rhythm twists around the baseline, the complexes growing and shrinking like a ribbon. [pause 0.4] It can stop on its own, or turn into Vee-fib. [pause 0.45] If it keeps going, defibrillate right away, pulse or not, and start CPR if there's no pulse. [pause 0.35] I-V magnesium helps stop it coming back. [pause 0.5] Practice it on A-C-L-S med Sim. [pause 0.35] A-C-L-S med dot com. [pause 1.2]
